what: Critical design constraint: single-BGP SPARQL discipline
title: AGENTS.md
text: librdf C library rdflib wraps serious correctness performance bugs conjunctive triple patterns graph’s scale. Multi-pattern SPARQL queries: Joins via shared variables (?s P1 ?o1. ?s P2 ?o2) hang many minutes. Multi-property selects single subject silently return zero rows. Single basic graph patterns (one triple match per query) execute correctly milliseconds. package’s design discipline therefore: SPARQL queries single basic graph patterns. Joins, multi-property assembly, aggregation happen R via dplyr. implemented R/sparql-helpers.R. two primitives (sparql_pairs, sparql_subjects) issue exactly one triple match; domain helpers (framework_metadata, role_framework_bindings, element_framework_bindings, role_element_bindings, element_text) compose one single-BGP calls join R. , agent, asked write multi-pattern SPARQL query package’s graphs: don’t. title: SPARQL query strategy
text: librdf C library rdflib wraps exhibits poor performance silent zero-row results conjunctive triple patterns graph’s scale. Multi-pattern SPARQL joins via shared variables hang many minutes. Multi-property selects single subject silently return rows. Single basic graph patterns (one triple match per SPARQL call) execute fast correctly. package’s discipline therefore: SPARQL queries single basic graph patterns. One triple match per call. Joins, multi-property assembly, aggregation happen R via dplyr. implemented helpers R/sparql-helpers.R: sparql_pairs(rdf, predicate) returns subject-object pairs triples given predicate. sparql_subjects(rdf, predicate, object) returns subjects triples whose predicate object fixed.
